Audit posterior calibration via Simulation-Based Calibration (SBC)

Source: R/audit-sbc.R
audit_sbc.Rd

Implements Simulation-Based Calibration (Talts et al., 2018) for Bayesian or posterior-sampling estimators. Repeatedly draws true parameters \(\tilde{\theta} \sim p(\theta)\), simulates synthetic data \(\tilde{y} \sim p(y \mid \tilde{\theta})\), draws \(L\) posterior samples, and evaluates uniformity of the rank statistics via Pearson's chi-square test and a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test, together with empirical 50% and 90% central credible-interval coverage.

Usage

audit_sbc(
  prior,
  dgp,
  posterior_draws,
  n_sim = 100L,
  n_bins = 10L,
  seed = 42L,
  mc_alpha = 0.01
)

Arguments

prior

Function of zero arguments returning a numeric vector (or named numeric scalar) drawn from the prior distribution \(p(\theta)\).

dgp

Function function(theta) simulating data from the likelihood given parameter vector theta.

posterior_draws

Function function(data) returning posterior draws: either a numeric vector of length \(L\) (for a scalar parameter) or an \(L \times p\) numeric matrix/data frame (columns matching parameters).

n_sim

Integer number of SBC replications (default 100L).

n_bins

Integer number of histogram bins for the chi-square uniformity test (default 10L).

seed

Integer RNG seed for reproducibility (default 42L).

mc_alpha

Significance threshold for failing uniformity tests (default 0.01). Values between mc_alpha and 0.05 emit "warn".

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_sbc" containing summary (a tibble::tibble per parameter), ranks (matrix of rank statistics), bin_counts, n_sim, n_draws, n_bins, and status.

Examples

# Exact Normal-Normal conjugate posterior (calibrated -> PASS)
sbc <- audit_sbc(
  prior = function() c(mu = rnorm(1, 0, 2)),
  dgp = function(theta) rnorm(20, mean = theta[["mu"]], sd = 1),
  posterior_draws = function(y) {
    post_var <- 1 / (1 / 4 + length(y))
    post_mean <- post_var * sum(y)
    rnorm(99, mean = post_mean, sd = sqrt(post_var))
  },
  n_sim = 80L,
  n_bins = 10L,
  seed = 42L
)
sbc
#> [WARN] Simulation-Based Calibration (SBC): 80/80 reps, L = 99 draws, 10 bins
#> [WARN] mu: chi2 p = 0.9643, KS p = 0.9541, 50% cov = 47.5%, 90% cov = 78.8%
